title: Base coherence of raw pullbacks
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $I$ any preorder and $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Over}(S)$ any diagram with cone $c$. Write $g_i:X_i\to S$, $g:X\to S$, $a_f:X_j\to X_i$ and $a_i:X\to X_i$ for its structure, transition and cone maps. Let $F_i$ be abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], with coefficient maps $\varphi_f:a_f^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], satisfying $\varphi_{1_i}=e_{X_i,F_i}$ and $\varphi_{f;g}=C_{a_g,a_f,F_i};a_g^{-1}(\varphi_f);\varphi_g$, where $e$ is the canonical inverse-image identity comparison and $C:(a_g;a_f)^{-1}\simeq a_g^{-1}a_f^{-1}$ is the canonical composition comparison. These equalities include the canonical transports along the identity and composition equalities of $D$. Let $H:I\to\mathrm{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{et}},\mathbf{Ab})$ have a colimit, with $eH_i:H_i\simeq a_i^{-1}F_i$ and canonical transition equation $H(f)=eH_i;\mathrm{upperStarComp};a_j^{-1}(\varphi_f);eH_j^{-1}$. Fix $p\in\mathbf N$. Put $A_i=\mathrm{raw}(g_i,p,F_i)$ and $Z=\mathrm{raw}(g,p,\operatorname{colim}H)$, the derived-Hom presheaves of [lem-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-natural-comparison]. There exist natural transformations $\tau_f:A_i\to A_j$ and $\beta_i:A_i\to Z$, whose components at every etale $V\to S$ are the explicit raw pullbacks along $(a_f,\varphi_f)$ and $(a_i,eH_i^{-1};\iota_i)$ respectively. They satisfy $\tau_{1_i}=1$ and $\tau_{f;f'}=\tau_f;\tau_{f'}$. No directedness, nonemptiness, limit, affineness or qcqs assumption is needed.

proof.text: Construct an additive homomorphism using homAddMap: its five factors are fixed source morphisms, the additive derived inverse-image functor on the class, and fixed target morphisms. For restrictions, use naturality of upperStarComp.hom and mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor directly inside rawPullbackMapGeneral, rewriting preservation of composition and associativity. Bundle these components in the generic categorical rawPullbackMapGeneral and specialize to the exact right-associated free-sheaf functor defining the raw presheaf, obtaining rawPullbackMap. The component formula holds by rfl. Specialize to D.map f.op and c.π.app (op i), with coefficient maps φ f and (eH i).inv followed by colimit.ι H i, producing τ and β.

Apply the proved generic presheaf_map_ext helper, which uses NatTrans.ext and AddCommGrpCat.ext. Rewrite rawPullbackMap_app at each test object. Functor.map_id, projected to the left morphism in Over, supplies the scheme identity transport for abelianHigherDirectImageRawPullback_identity. Functor.map_comp g.op f.op, projected to the left morphism, supplies the composite transport for abelianHigherDirectImageRawPullback_composition. Apply these pointwise laws using hφid and hφcomp, and the Over.w proofs. The component equations and the two extensional equalities assemble the requested existential conjunction. hH is unnecessary for these four clauses.
